protocols.name: str_activity_assay
protocols.title: Strictosidine synthase activity assay
text: Add 50 uL of 1 mM tryptamine in phosphate buffer to a 2 mL vial.

protocols.name: suzuki_coupling
protocols.title: Suzuki cross-coupling
text: Add 1 mL of toluene to a 50 mL flask.
Add 2 mL of aryl bromide solution.
Add 2 mL of boronic acid solution.
Wash with 5 mL of ethyl acetate.

protocols.name: amide_coupling
protocols.title: HATU amide coupling
text: Add 2 mL of DMF to a 50 mL flask.

protocols.name: reductive_amination
protocols.title: Reductive amination
text: Add 1 mL of aldehyde solution to a 15 mL tube.

protocols.name: recrystallisation
protocols.title: Recrystallisation from ethanol
text: Add 20 mL of ethanol to a 50 mL flask.
Wash with 5 mL of cold ethanol.

protocols.name: hplc_sample_prep
protocols.title: Plasma protein precipitation for HPLC
text: Add 100 uL of plasma to a 2 mL vial.

protocols.name: overflow_variant
protocols.title: STR assay with an oversized aliquot
text: Add 5 mL of tryptamine solution to a 2 mL vial.

protocols.name: overheat_variant
protocols.title: Coupling at an impossible block temperature
text: Add 1 mL of DMF to a 15 mL tube.

protocols.name: flammable_variant
protocols.title: Diethyl ether heated above its flash point
text: Add 5 mL of diethyl ether to a 50 mL flask.

protocols.name: missing_volume_variant
protocols.title: Quench without a stated volume
text: Add 100 uL of substrate to a 2 mL vial.

protocols.name: zero_duration_variant
protocols.title: Incubation with a zero duration
text: Add 100 uL of substrate to a 2 mL vial.
